settings.question: Where can I check my order?
settings.answer: Sign in to your customer account to review your order history and open the order you want to check.

settings.question: Can I change an order after checkout?
settings.answer: Contact the support team as soon as possible. Changes may not be possible once an order has entered processing or dispatch.

settings.question: Why has my tracking not updated?
settings.answer: A carrier may need time to scan a parcel after dispatch, and updates can pause between facilities. Contact support if the expected delivery window has passed.

settings.question: Where can I find product details?
settings.answer: Check the product page for the description, available options and any item-specific guidance supplied by the store.

settings.question: How should I care for my purchase?
settings.answer: Follow any care instructions included with the item or shown on its product page. Contact support before using an unlisted cleaning or maintenance method.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Review the Shipping & Returns page, then contact support with your order number and the item you would like to return.

settings.question: What should I include when contacting support?
settings.answer: Include your order number when relevant, a concise description of the issue and clear photos if an item arrived damaged.
